## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(car) 
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## LOAD MODEL RESULTS

### UNADJUSTED

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

unadj_m3AA_summaries_df <- readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/unadjusted_primaryexposuresSept222026.RDS")
unadj_m3GM_summaries_df <- readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/unadjusted_primaryexposuresGMSept222026.RDS")

```

### DEMOGRAPHIC 

```{r}

adj_demoAA_summaries_dfm1 <- readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_AAdemographicSept222026.RDS")
adj_demohGM_summaries_dfm1 <- readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_GMdemographicSept222026.RDS")

```

### HEALTH

### SOCIOECONOMIC AND BEHAVIOR

```{r}

adj_GMrural_summaries_dfm3 <- readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_gm3ruralSept222026.RDS")

adj_GMschlyrs_summaries_dfm3 <-readRDS("Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_gm3schlyrsSept222026.RDS")
```

# GET DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS

### UNADJUSTED

```{r, warning=FALSE}

combined_plot1 <- perform_diagnostics(unadj_m3AA_summaries_df[[1]]$model, names(unadj_m3AA_summaries_df)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plot2 <- perform_diagnostics(unadj_m3GM_summaries_df[[1]]$model, names(unadj_m3GM_summaries_df)[1]) #global methylation

combined_plot1
combined_plot2

```

### DEMOGRAPHIC

```{r, warning=FALSE}

combined_plotdemoAA <- perform_diagnostics(adj_demoAA_summaries_dfm1[[1]]$model, names(adj_demoAA_summaries_dfm1)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plotdemoGM <- perform_diagnostics(adj_demohGM_summaries_dfm1[[1]]$model, names(adj_demohGM_summaries_dfm1)[1]) #global methylation

combined_plotdemoAA
combined_plotdemoGM

```

### SOCIOECONOMIC AND BEHAVIOR

```{r, warning=FALSE}

  ## Grew up in a rural area
combined_plot1 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_AArural_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_AArural_summaries_dfm3)[1]) #age acceleration
combined_plot2 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_GMrural_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_GMrural_summaries_dfm3)[1]) #global methylation
  ## Years in school
combined_plot3 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_AAschlyrs_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_AAschlyrs_summaries_dfm3)[1])
combined_plot4 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_GMschlyrs_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_GMschlyrs_summaries_dfm3)[1])
  ## Live with a grandparent
combined_plot5 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_AAlivegpar_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_AAlivegpar_summaries_dfm3)[1])
combined_plot6 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_GMlivegpar_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_GMlivegpar_summaries_dfm3)[1])
  ## Smoking during childhood
combined_plot7 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_AAchsmk_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_AAchsmk_summaries_dfm3)[1])
combined_plot8 <- perform_diagnostics(adj_GMchsmk_summaries_dfm3[[1]]$model, names(adj_GMchsmk_summaries_dfm3)[1])
```
